title: Figure 13: Design of an IEC Jet Thruster - Experimental Device Photo and Schematic
description: Left panel is a color photograph looking into a red-glowing spherical IEC chamber with a bright plasma jet emerging from the central grid. Right panel is a schematic showing the accelerating grid, xenon feed, insulator, electron emitters, electron guide, a -1 kV supply and +100 V bias, with the plasma jet exiting to the left. Caption: 'Figure 13. Design of an IEC Jet Thruster - Experimental Device (left)'.
